assumptions.choice: Each entry uses floor(1% of current broker value / current close) shares.
assumptions.reason: The specification caps each order at 1% of capital but does not prescribe share rounding or a capital valuation method.

assumptions.choice: Entries meeting the same directional signal add lots while in that direction, capped at three total open lots.
assumptions.reason: The specification permits additions and explicitly limits simultaneously open lots to three; this explicit cap governs the initial position plus additions.

assumptions.choice: Exit signals are evaluated against each completed bar's close relative to every recorded lot entry price.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives price percentages but does not prescribe stop-order types or intrabar execution precedence.

assumptions.choice: Short entries use self.sell(size=...) and short exits use self.close().
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly defines a short-position condition.
